text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross and I go to see a trending
fantasy
flick, but after leaving the
cinema, I can't help
feeling she's
behaving a little... strangely.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh! If it isn't Tamtam and her trainer.
Fancy
seeing the two of you here!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Did you see Blue the Magician and the Secret Isle ? It's awesome, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, it was! But what are the chances
of us
bumpin' into you two!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That film had so many cute, creative
critters in it.
Seeing them all was such a
delight!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
One of them had a flower growing out of
its head.
I wonder if they have to water
that flower every
morning.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, I, uh, bet they do... Watchin'
that film
was like visitin' a zoo of magical
creatures. It was
real fun. Ha... haha...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go, um... I'm gonna check out
the
p-potted plants over there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross scurries off. I chase after
her, and
when I catch up...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Yeah, I'm doin' real good...
How
come?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh. Well, maybe "real good" is a stretch.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I... can't handle anythin' gooey or sticky.
Same
with slimy foods. Natto? I can't
even look at it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Back when I was a kid, I had a cup of
pudding I
was savin' for a special
occasion. I was keepin' it
safe, waitin' for
the right moment, but then...

text_block_list.name: Young Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
What happened to my pudding?! It's all
white 'n
sticky now!

text_block_list.name: Young Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what do I do?! I gotta eat it fast
before it
gets any worse!

text_block_list.name: Young Tamamo
text_block_list.text: Munch. Urk?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...As you'd imagine, that didn't go well.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... So just now, when all those slimy
blob
guys showed up at the climax...
choice_data_list: I'm so glad you're all right...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't handle it. I was gettin'
shivers—it felt
like the big gooey mess
was seepin' outta the
screen and into my
brain...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I just made myself feel worse.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, don't mind me! We didn't come all
the way
here just to sit around!
choice_data_list: Want me to carry you home on my back?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya wanted to buy somethin', right? We
haven't
even hit the shops yet. 'Sides...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking a reluctant Tamamo Cross by the
hand, I
lead her to the mall's reception
desk.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: We do. I'll show you the way.
choice_data_list: Excuse me, is there somewhere I can rest?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for this. Sometimes... ya really
come
through for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Tamamo Cross's condition
improves, the
two of us go and grab
some warm udon.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A piggyback?! I'm not a kid! C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're just bein' a worrywart. I've just
gotta clear
my head and forget all about
the sticky stuff!
choice_data_list: Still, you don't look well, so...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
C'mon brain, forget all the gross, gooey
stuff! All
the nasty... oozy...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Urp...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm fine!
choice_data_list: I'm carrying you home on my back after all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Is what I wanna say, but I'm not gonna talk ya outta this, am I?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sorry for makin' ya do this, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I slowly carry her home, Tamamo
Cross drifts
off to sleep. Everything's
quiet, save for her soft
breaths...
